subtasks: Pick up the broom, hand it over to the right hand, then use the dustpan to sweep the blocks.
Sweep the remaining lime block at the far side of the dustpan mouth into the dustpan with the right-hand broom.
Leave the loaded dustpan on the table, set the broom down to its right, release both tools and return both empty arms to their starting poses.
Return both empty arms to their starting poses with grippers open; leave the dustpan, blocks and broom untouched.
